name: Dotdigital
description: Dotdigital provides email, SMS, WhatsApp, automation, contact, campaign, transactional messaging, and customer-data APIs.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated customer-owned API user. Relay discovers and allowlists the account region, then pins four operations: bounded address-book inventory and exact-address-book reads run directly, while one exact contact read and one subscription-state update require approval. The update requires contact authorization and subscription additionally requires double-opt-in evidence.

credentialRequirements.name: DOTDIGITAL_API_USERNAME
credentialRequirements.label: Dotdigital API username
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated customer-owned API user with least-privilege address-book and contact access.

credentialRequirements.name: DOTDIGITAL_API_PASSWORD
credentialRequirements.label: Dotdigital API password
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay uses this only for Basic authentication to the fixed discovery and allowlisted regional API origins.

capabilities.label: Read address books
capabilities.description: Use bounded address-book inventory and exact-address-book reads.

capabilities.label: Read contact
capabilities.description: Use one exact email-contact lookup with approval.

capabilities.label: Manage one contact
capabilities.description: Use one contact subscription-state update with approval and consent enforcement.

allowed.label: Read Dotdigital address books
allowed.description: Read a bounded address-book inventory or one exact address book.

approvalRequired.label: Manage Dotdigital contact
approvalRequired.description: Update one authorized contact's email subscription state.

blocked.label: Expose credentials
blocked.description: API credentials, Basic authorization, and credential-bearing fields never enter agent-visible inputs or results.

blocked.label: Run bulk transfers
blocked.description: Contact collections, imports, exports, bulk deletes, suppression downloads, and unbounded address-book traversal are excluded.

blocked.label: Send or administer campaigns
blocked.description: Campaign sends, programs, transactional email, SMS, WhatsApp, Insight data, preferences, address-book mutations, and contact deletes remain provider-side.

blocked.label: Use arbitrary APIs
blocked.description: Only four pinned v2/v3 routes run after fixed regional discovery; arbitrary origins, paths, queries, fields, headers, resubscribe overrides, and oversized results are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded address-book reads run directly; exact contact reads and one-contact writes require approval, writes require contact authorization, and subscription additionally requires double-opt-in evidence.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All four selected operations run without Relay per-action approval; authorization/double-opt-in attestations, fixed regional routing, bounds, audits, and bulk/send/admin blocks remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway discovers and allowlists the account region, then mounts four pinned Dotdigital v2/v3 operations without exposing Basic credentials.

providerSetup.blocker: Dotdigital requires a customer-owned least-privilege API user, password, address books, contacts, and permission-based contact acquisition. No console, API user, credentials, address book, contact, consent, Railway environment, or deployment is allowed in this worker.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a dedicated staging API user outside this worker with only address-book and contact access, configure credentials in Railway staging, and verify regional discovery, address-book/contact reads, approval and contact/double-opt-in denial/allow, subscribe/unsubscribe behavior without resubscribe override, response bounds, credential rotation, pause/disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Dotdigital documents the r1/r2/r3 regional APIs, account-info endpoint discovery, TLS requirements, and current Contacts API guidance.
